resource.conclusion: Tumor next-generation sequencing: ARID1A c.5161C>T (p.Arg1721*) and c.6504_6505insT (p.Val2169fs); AXIN1 c.1939dupC (p.Arg647fs); additional variants of uncertain significance. Microsatellite stable; TMB 1.3 mutations/Mb. Candidate trials: NCT05023655 (tazemetostat, ARID1A) and NCT06005974 (REC-4881, AXIN1). Detailed variant-level results are maintained on the genomics server, not in this report.
